concept.definition: Classify each statement as fact, inference, or uncertain. A fact is explicitly asserted by the source text, an inference is a conclusion or causal claim not explicitly asserted, and uncertain means the available information is insufficient to decide.

tasks.input: The report explicitly states that revenue was 10 million dollars.
Revenue probably increased because website traffic increased.
The source omits the final sales number, so the result cannot be determined.
The minutes say the meeting began at 09:00.
The team must have shipped early because customer complaints decreased.

concept.definition: Assign a priority. HIGH means service unavailable or data loss. MEDIUM means degraded behavior with a workaround. LOW means cosmetic or documentation-only impact.

tasks.input: All users receive a 503 and cannot sign in.
Exports are slower than usual, but retrying completes successfully.
A heading has a spelling mistake; functionality is unaffected.
Saved records disappeared after the migration.
The chart fails to refresh automatically, but a manual refresh works.

concept.definition: Normalize the provided identifier by trimming surrounding whitespace, converting letters to lowercase, replacing every internal run of spaces with one hyphen, and leaving digits unchanged.
